cat-2026.route: One CAT registration covers them all

fms-delhi.checkNote: Fee, eligibility and selection weights are from the FMS bulletin. The bulletin does not print the closing date, so 25 Nov comes from MBAUniverse and Careers360.

facts.label: Eligibility
facts.value: 50% in graduation

facts.label: Shortlist
facts.value: On your CAT score, weighted VARC 40%, DILR 30%, QA 30%

facts.label: Final selection
facts.value: CAT 50%, Class X 10%, Class XII 10%, statement of purpose 10%, extempore 5%, interview 15%

facts.label: Programme fee
facts.value: About ₹65,075 a semester

fms-delhi.name: FMS Delhi
fms-delhi.notes: Asks for your CAT 2026 registration number. Last year the deadline slipped by two days, but do not plan around an extension.

stages.label: Interview shortlist

facts.label: Interview cities
facts.value: Include Mumbai, Delhi and Bangalore

facts.label: Programme fee
facts.value: ₹19.73 lakh for the 2026-28 batch. The 2027-29 figure comes with the offer letter

iift.name: IIFT
iift.notes: Delhi is the tier 1 campus. The same MBA (IB) form also covers Kolkata, Kakinada and GIFT City.

iit-bombay-sjmsom.checkNote: SJMSOM's site still shows the 2026-28 schedule and its application portal is not active yet.

facts.label: Eligibility
facts.value: 60% or 6.5 CPI in graduation

iit-bombay-sjmsom.name: IIT Bombay (SJMSOM)
iit-bombay-sjmsom.notes: Needs 60% in graduation. The form usually opens around the CAT result. Exact dates are not out yet.
iit-bombay-sjmsom.windowText: Expected first week to last week of Jan 2027

facts.label: Eligibility
facts.value: 60% or 6.0 CGPA in graduation

facts.label: Form fee
facts.value: About ₹1,600 last cycle. Not on the DMS site yet

iit-delhi-dms.feeText: About ₹1,600 for one programme (last cycle's figure, confirm when the form opens)
iit-delhi-dms.name: IIT Delhi (DMS)
iit-delhi-dms.notes: Needs 60% in graduation. Opens the day after CAT, so there is nothing to do before the exam.

stages.label: Interview
stages.when: To be updated soon, says DMS

isb-pgp.checkNote: Round 2 (6 Dec 2026) and Round 3 (17 Jan 2027) deadlines are from ISB's own deadlines page. The form fee is not shown there, so the fee is not confirmed officially.
isb-pgp.name: ISB (PGP)
isb-pgp.notes: Only worth it if you plan to take the GMAT or GRE. Needs 24 months of full-time work by the programme start. This is Round 2; Round 3 closes 17 Jan 2027. ISB's CAT route (PGP YL) is only for people with under 24 months of work.
isb-pgp.route: GMAT or GRE only, not CAT

jbims-mah-cet.checkNote: The CET Cell site has nothing for 2027 yet. Last cycle, registration ran from 10 Jan to 20 Feb 2026.
jbims-mah-cet.feeText: Not announced (₹1,000 to ₹1,500 reported for the open category)
jbims-mah-cet.name: JBIMS Mumbai (through MAH-MBA/MMS CET 2027)
jbims-mah-cet.notes: The CET Cell has not released the 2027 schedule yet. JBIMS fills its seats through Maharashtra's CAP counselling around July, using MAH-CET, CAT or CMAT scores.

facts.label: Eligibility
facts.value: 50% in Class X, Class XII and graduation

facts.label: No edits
facts.value: Personal and academic details cannot be changed after you submit

facts.label: Work experience
facts.value: Can be updated till 31 Mar 2027 if you are shortlisted

facts.label: PGDM-IB
facts.value: Needs 1 year of work experience as on 31 Jan 2027

mdi-gurgaon.feeText: ₹3,000 for every MDI Gurgaon programme. ₹3,590 if you add MDI Murshidabad
mdi-gurgaon.name: MDI Gurgaon
mdi-gurgaon.notes: Closes at 5 PM on the evening before CAT, and you cannot correct the form after submitting. Finish it well before exam week.

nmat-nmims.name: NMIMS Mumbai (through NMAT 2026)
nmat-nmims.notes: Registration for this cycle is over (NMAT closed 25 Oct, the NMIMS form 31 Oct). Listed so you know it is off the table unless you had already registered.

snap-sibm-pune.checkNote: Closing date, test dates and result date are from the SNAP important dates page. The fee was not re-read on the official site today.
snap-sibm-pune.feeText: ₹2,550 per test + ₹1,000 per programme, taxes extra
snap-sibm-pune.name: SIBM Pune (through SNAP 2026)
snap-sibm-pune.notes: Most lists place SIBM Pune just below tier 1. Apply only if you want a backup with its own exam in December.

stages.label: SNAP result
stages.note: SNAP says the schedule can change in unavoidable circumstances.

xat-xlri.feeText: ₹2,300 for XAT + ₹200 per XLRI programme (₹2,700 for BM and HRM)
